scope: Build an independently evaluable DeepSeek to native OpenUI answer format before integrating it into authenticated Workspace.

keep: Current Workspace presentation, stored conversations, canonical provider and accounting
extend: Owner-only standalone evaluation and safe native model-authored presentation

schemaImpact.rollout: Standalone route disabled unless explicitly configured. No stored messages or database schema changed.
schemaImpact.rollback: Unset evaluator configuration. Restore previous staging artifacts if needed.

auth.description: New disabled-by-default evaluation path uses current verified founder identity, owner role and AAL2.

tenant.description: Existing issued tenant context and caller-scoped current role lookup; no cross-tenant data or application state mutation.

approval.description: Model output cannot confer authority; browser UI state changes are local.

credentials.description: Existing server provider and caller-scoped Auth client. No key or credential changes.

egress.description: New bounded evaluator reaches only the existing authenticated API, Auth project, canonical model and accounting. No renderer telemetry or model-directed external egress.

cost.description: One metered model answer per admitted evaluation; requires explicit staging spending decision.

billing.description: Uses canonical quota, reservation and provider usage settlement.

tests.scope: Registry instructions, output framing, bounded parser, local state and untrusted-model abuse cases
Browser fixtures across ten viewport and theme combinations with calculator, graph, accessibility and egress checks

architecture.reason: New standalone presentation surface uses the existing model dispatch; no competing orchestration, database or provider.

rollout: No production deployment. Resolve source gates, then obtain approved authenticated isolated evaluator acceptance.
rollback: Remove the evaluator environment settings. Workspace source remains unaffected.
knownGaps: Live DeepSeek and provider-streaming verification await an authorized isolated staging target and provider binding.
Workspace persistence, Copy/Share/Reopen and migration pending the standalone live gate.
Main source-bound security and sidebar checks need reconciliation.

blockers: Isolated staging model and auth configuration, explicit capped inference authorization, and inherited source and security gates remain outstanding.
